items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I identify him with Armstrong's band, with the Louie Russell band.

ctx.x: Yeah, okay. I was wondering, you told me once before about Pops Foster, that you'd heard him on the record. You...

Well, I heard him, and my only recollection of him is being with Louie. I identify him with Armstrong's band, with the Louie Russell band. I remember having seen him here at different spots in New Orleans. At the Coliseum for one place. And other places, the names of which I can't recall at the moment.
Sure. What about early dance bands? Can you remember the very first dance music?
